Class View.InventoryTilesView

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.LabelWithImageAndText
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.InventoryTilesView
Enclosing class:
View
public static class View.InventoryTilesView extends View.LabelWithImageAndText
Concrete implementation of LabelWithImageAndText for items in the Player's inventory. These are purely visual indicators (non-clickable) showing what the player has collected.
